 The Brazilian, who was injured on April 21 against Alavés, entered the field in the 85th minute and was applauded by the Bernabéu crowd.
 NEWS. 18/10/2026 Éder Militão returned to action with Real Madrid in the victory against Sevilla at the Santiago Bernabéu , 180 days   after suffering a rupture of the proximal tendon of the biceps femoris in his left leg. The Brazilian sustained the injury on April 21, 2026, during the match against Alavés at the Bernabéu , corresponding to matchday 33 of LaLiga .
 Seven days later, he underwent surgery and subsequently began a recovery process that culminated with his return to the pitch against Sevilla. After gradually rejoining training sessions with his teammates, Militão started the match on the bench and, in the 85th minute, replaced Valverde .
